10.content:
### ArgoCD Sync and Deployment Pulse

This dashboard provides a comprehensive view of the status of ArgoCD Application States and sync notifications related to the deployment of new applications. It is designed to help platform engineers and DevOps teams monitor and manage their applications and deployment processes effectively.

11.query:
fetch events 
| filter event.kind == "SDLC_EVENT" 
| filter event.category == "task" 
| filter event.type == "deployment"
| filter event.status == "finished" 
| filter event.provider == "argocd"
| filter in(cicd.deployment.name, $Application)
| filter in(cicd.deployment.namespace, $Namespace)
| filter in(argocd.app.project.name, $Project)
| summarize errorRate = if(count() == 0, 0, else: toDouble(countIf(task.outcome == "failed")) / toDouble(count())*100)
11.title: Error rate

12.query:
fetch events
| filter event.kind == "SDLC_EVENT"
| filter event.category == "task" 
| filter event.type == "deployment" 
| filter event.status == "finished" 
| filter event.provider == "argocd"
| filter task.outcome == "succeeded"
| filter in(cicd.deployment.name, $Application)
| filter in(cicd.deployment.namespace, $Namespace)
| filter in(argocd.app.project.name, $Project)
| summarize count(), by:{argocd.app.health.status}
12.title: Application Health Status after Successful Sync

17.query:
fetch events | filter event.provider == "argocd" 
| filter isNotNull(argocd.app.reconciliation.time)

| filter in(cicd.deployment.namespace, $Namespace)

| dedup {cicd.deployment.name, cicd.deployment.namespace, end_time, vcs.ref.base.revision}, sort:{argocd.app.reconciliation.time desc}
| fields AppName= cicd.deployment.name, Version = argocd.app.version, Namespace = cicd.deployment.namespace , Status = task.outcome , Health = argocd.app.health.status, DeployedBy = argocd.sync.initiated_by, DeploymentNo = argocd.app.deployment_count, SyncToRev = vcs.ref.base.revision, PreviousRev = vcs.ref.previous.revision, Image = argocd.app.image, Duration = duration, Started = start_time, Ended = end_time, Message = argocd.sync.operation_state.outcome, Repository = vcs.repository.url.full, RepositoryRef = vcs.ref.base.name,Project = argocd.app.project.name, Stage = argocd.app.stage, Parent = argocd.app.parent, ChartPath = argocd.app.source.path, AppURL = cicd.deployment.ingress.url, Resources = argocd.sync.resources, Server = cicd.deployment.server.url.full
| sort Ended desc
| limit 20

23.query:
fetch events 
| filter event.kind == "SDLC_EVENT" 
| filter event.category == "task" 
| filter event.type == "deployment"

| fields timestamp, argocd.app.name, argocd.app.version, argocd.sync.initiated_by, argocd.sync.operation_state.outcome, prompt, execute, contexts

30.content:
### Versions and Releases

Current version (container image tag) of each application, who deployed it, apps waiting for promotion, and the version history. Versions come from the enriched Argo CD SDLC events (subscribed apps, events after the pipeline update); health and sync come from Argo CD metrics.

---

31.query:
fetch events
| filter event.kind == "SDLC_EVENT" and event.provider == "argocd" and event.status == "finished"
| filter in(cicd.deployment.name, $Application)
| filter in(cicd.deployment.namespace, $Namespace)
| filter in(argocd.app.project.name, $Project)
| sort timestamp desc
| summarize {Version = takeFirst(argocd.app.version), Stage = takeFirst(argocd.app.stage), Status = takeFirst(task.outcome), LastDeployed = takeFirst(timestamp), DeployedBy = takeFirst(argocd.sync.initiated_by), SyncToRev = takeFirst(vcs.ref.base.revision), Image = takeFirst(argocd.app.image), Parent = takeFirst(argocd.app.parent), Owner = takeFirst(argocd.app.owner), AppURL = takeFirst(cicd.deployment.ingress.url)}, by: {AppName = cicd.deployment.name}
| sort AppName asc
31.title: Current version per application

32.query:
timeseries v = avg(argocd_app_info), by: {Name = name, Health = health_status, Sync = sync_status, Namespace = dest_namespace, Project = project}, shift: -1m, interval: 1m
| filter in(Name, $Application)
| filter in(Namespace, $Namespace)
| filter in(Project, $Project)
| fieldsRemove v
| lookup [ fetch events, from: now() - 90d
  | filter event.kind == "SDLC_EVENT" and event.provider == "argocd" and event.status == "finished"
  | filter in(cicd.deployment.name, $Application)
  | filter in(cicd.deployment.namespace, $Namespace)
  | filter in(argocd.app.project.name, $Project)
  | sort timestamp desc
  | summarize {Version = takeFirst(argocd.app.version), Stage = takeFirst(argocd.app.stage), Status = takeFirst(task.outcome), LastDeployed = takeFirst(timestamp), DeployedBy = takeFirst(argocd.sync.initiated_by), SyncToRev = takeFirst(vcs.ref.base.revision), Image = takeFirst(argocd.app.image), Parent = takeFirst(argocd.app.parent), Owner = takeFirst(argocd.app.owner), AppURL = takeFirst(cicd.deployment.ingress.url)}, by: {AppName = cicd.deployment.name}
  ], sourceField: Name, lookupField: AppName, prefix: "dep."
| fields AppName = Name, Health, Sync, Version = coalesce(`dep.Version`, "not subscribed"), LastDeployed = `dep.LastDeployed`, Namespace, Project
| sort AppName asc
32.title: All applications: health, sync and version

33.query:
timeseries v = avg(argocd_app_info), by: {Name = name, Health = health_status, Sync = sync_status, Namespace = dest_namespace, Project = project}, shift: -1m, interval: 1m
| filter in(Name, $Application)
| filter in(Namespace, $Namespace)
| filter in(Project, $Project)
| fieldsRemove v
| filter Health == "Suspended"
| fields AppName = Name, Health, Sync, Namespace, Project
| sort AppName asc
33.title: Waiting for promotion (Suspended)

34.query:
fetch events
| filter event.kind == "SDLC_EVENT" and event.provider == "argocd" and event.status == "finished"
| filter in(cicd.deployment.name, $Application)
| filter in(cicd.deployment.namespace, $Namespace)
| filter in(argocd.app.project.name, $Project)
| dedup vcs.ref.base.revision, start_time, cicd.deployment.name
| summarize Deployments = count(), by: {DeployedBy = coalesce(argocd.sync.initiated_by, "unknown")}
| sort Deployments desc
34.title: Deployments by initiator

35.query:
fetch events
| filter event.kind == "SDLC_EVENT" and event.provider == "argocd" and event.status == "finished"
| filter in(cicd.deployment.name, $Application)
| filter in(cicd.deployment.namespace, $Namespace)
| filter in(argocd.app.project.name, $Project)
| sort timestamp desc
| fields Deployed = timestamp, AppName = cicd.deployment.name, Version = argocd.app.version, Status = task.outcome, DeployedBy = argocd.sync.initiated_by, DeploymentNo = argocd.app.deployment_count, SyncToRev = vcs.ref.base.revision, PreviousRev = vcs.ref.previous.revision, Duration = duration
| limit 200
35.title: Version history
